name: GAMEMAX Linux Apps
target: GAMEMAX IceBurg Digital Software / PcInfoMonitorPro.exe V1.0.0.04

summary.en: Python HID sender and PySide6 tray app that display Linux system readings on a GAMEMAX IceBurg cooler's LCD.
summary.zh-CN: 通过 Python HID 发送器和 PySide6 托盘程序，将 Linux 系统监测数据显示在 GAMEMAX IceBurg 水冷的 LCD 上。

rea.en: The protocol report records REA 6.4.0, Ghidra 12.1.2 and a local IL dumper used to analyze the Windows vendor software.
rea.zh-CN: 协议报告记录了使用 REA 6.4.0、Ghidra 12.1.2 和本地 IL 工具分析厂商 Windows 软件的过程。

limitations.en: The author tested an IceBurg 240 Digital BK; compatibility with other panel revisions remains unverified.
limitations.zh-CN: 作者测试了 IceBurg 240 Digital BK，其他面板版本的兼容性尚未验证。

summary.en: Python serial controller, MQTT daemon and Home Assistant integration for the Yamaha RX-V2500 receiver.
summary.zh-CN: 面向 Yamaha RX-V2500 功放的 Python 串口控制器、MQTT 守护程序和 Home Assistant 接入。

rea.en: The author credits REA binary inspection of YamahaReceiverEditor3.exe for recovering command frames and report decoding.
rea.zh-CN: 作者明确记录了使用 REA 分析 YamahaReceiverEditor3.exe，以恢复命令帧和状态报告解析。

limitations.en: Hardware validation covers the RX-V2500, and the project implements device interoperability rather than the complete Windows editor.
limitations.zh-CN: 硬件验证范围为 RX-V2500，成果是设备互通客户端，未覆盖 Windows 编辑器的全部功能。

summary.en: C++20/WTL mouse-gesture prototype with trajectory matching, overlays, action execution and hook recovery.
summary.zh-CN: 使用 C++20/WTL 实现的鼠标手势原型，已有轨迹匹配、浮层、动作执行和钩子恢复功能。

rea.en: The project records REA 6.3.0 and Ghidra 12.1.4 analysis of MouseInc and Aitiy alongside behavioral observations and earlier public source references.
rea.zh-CN: 项目记录了通过 REA 6.3.0 和 Ghidra 12.1.4 分析 MouseInc、Aitiy，并结合行为观察与早期公开源码参考。

limitations.en: The core gesture path works according to the author, while settings, OCR, screenshots, hotkeys and other planned features remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: 作者报告核心手势链路已跑通，设置界面、OCR、截图、热键等计划功能仍未完成。

name: Kensington VeriMark IT Linux
target: Kensington VeriMark IT Windows driver 6.0.20.1123 / synaWudfBioUsb123.dll

summary.en: Patches to libfprint/synaTudorMiS add VeriMark IT fingerprint support and correct fingerprint deletion on Linux.
summary.zh-CN: 通过 libfprint/synaTudorMiS 补丁，为 Linux 增加 VeriMark IT 指纹支持并修正指纹删除流程。

rea.en: The findings identify the Windows driver by version and SHA256 and explicitly record analysis with REA and Ghidra.
rea.zh-CN: 研究记录给出 Windows 驱动版本与 SHA256，并明确说明使用 REA 和 Ghidra 进行分析。

limitations.en: The author tested firmware 10.1 enrollment, matching and login; suspend/resume and unplugging during an operation remain untested.
limitations.zh-CN: 作者测试了固件 10.1 的录入、匹配和登录，休眠恢复及操作中拔出设备尚未测试。

summary.en: Go CLI for Roborock status, settings, controls, history and maps over local TCP or cloud MQTT.
summary.zh-CN: 通过本地 TCP 或云 MQTT 访问石头扫地机器人的状态、设置、控制、历史和地图的 Go 命令行客户端。

rea.en: REA supplied APK identity evidence, while a REA class-search failure led to direct JADX analysis supplemented by python-roborock references.
rea.zh-CN: REA 提供了 APK 身份证据，类搜索失败后改用 JADX 直接分析，并参考 python-roborock。

limitations.en: REA's contribution was limited to package inspection, and the author reports live read-only checks on a QX Revo Plus with physical controls and A01/B01 hardware still unverified.
limitations.zh-CN: REA 的作用限于包检查；作者报告完成了 QX Revo Plus 只读实机检查，物理控制及 A01/B01 设备仍未实机验证。

summary.en: Rust/egui prototype for reading LD/LDX logs and viewing channels, metadata, time plots and beacons.
summary.zh-CN: 读取 LD/LDX 日志并显示通道、元数据、时间曲线和信标的 Rust/egui 原型。

rea.en: REA inspected installer identity and PE resources using portable operations, with evidence IDs retained in the research notes.
rea.zh-CN: REA 通过无需原生分析引擎的操作检查安装器身份和 PE 资源，研究记录保留了证据 ID。

limitations.en: The parser forks the existing MIT-licensed afonso360/motec-i2 library, and native i2 decompilation and full feature parity remain unachieved.
limitations.zh-CN: 解析器基于现有 MIT 许可的 afonso360/motec-i2 库，尚未完成 i2 原生反编译或完整功能对等。

name: ha-lixiang
target: Li Auto Android app / Li ONE vehicle support

summary.en: An existing Home Assistant integration gained Li ONE model configuration and additional vehicle-state mappings on October 12.
summary.zh-CN: 已有的 Home Assistant 集成于 10 月 12 日补齐理想 ONE 车型配置和更多车辆状态映射。

rea.en: The October 12 commit explicitly describes using REA to compare the official APK with the integration and identify missing M01A support.
rea.zh-CN: 10 月 12 日的提交明确记录了使用 REA 对比官方 APK 与集成代码，发现缺失的 M01A 支持。

limitations.en: The repository predates the review week, and some Li ONE control paths still require vehicle verification.
limitations.zh-CN: 仓库创建早于本次核查周，部分理想 ONE 控制通道仍需实车验证。
